Seon-Hwa, who senses the stench of evildoers, meets Jeong-Hyang, who has a scent for the first time in her life. However, Jeong-Hyang, who she thought was only good, is actually a witch who turns evildoers into flowers...

'Is there anyone you want to kill?'

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Part of YLAB's Red String Universe.
synonyms: The Witch's Judgment Turns into Flowers
ทัณฑ์ดอกไม้ของแม่มด

184300.description:
Ju-Han is a devout deacon who regularly volunteers at an orphanage where Seong-Mi resides. Drawn by curiosity, Seong-Mi visits the church, only to stumble upon a shocking sight—Ju-Han, the very picture of restraint and virtue, consumed by his own forbidden desires, punishing himself in secret. A dangerous temptation begins to take root.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

184302.description:
1. famiglia; COMIC HOTMILK 2020-11
2. pure love; COMIC Megastore Alpha 2019-07
3. Kankei no Yoru (姦計の夜); COMIC HOTMILK 2020-02
4. remember; COMIC HOTMILK 2020-06

title.native: エロゲ世界に転生した俺が、推しへの愛で寝取られヒロインを幸せにする。
title.romaji: Eroge Sekai ni Tensei Shita Ore ga, Oshi e no Ai de Netorare Heroine wo Shiawase ni Suru.

184307.description:
Keita Sato (41, single) is overworked at his corporate job, dealing with tedious and stressful tasks day in and out. How does he relieve his stress? By sneaking into modern-day "dungeons," using them as a batting cage, and blasting away ferocious monsters! One day, his live-in niece Hikari secretly follows him and livestreams his adventures, only for his unbelievable strength to go crazy viral!! Keita unknowingly captures the attention of not only viewers, but other big-name streamers. So begins the fantasy tale of an ordinary office worker's unwitting rise to fame and glory!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.english: The Plain Salary Man Turned Out to Be a Hero: He Was Invincible, Only to Be Exposed on His Niece's Dungeon Stream
title.native: 地味なおじさん、実は英雄でした。～自覚がないまま無双してたら、姪のダンジョン配信で晒されてたようです～
title.romaji: Jimi na Oji-san, Jitsu wa Eiyuu Deshita. Jikaku ga nai Mama Musou Shitetara, Mei no Dungeon Haishin de Sarasareteta You desu

184309.description:
Virgin Yuji Ubakata dies without ever experiencing sex, and when he lands in hell, he is greeted by the swimsuit-wearing god of hell, Enma! She tells him that he must face retribution for his life as a virgin, and he is sentenced to a very unique punishment... Yuji is then taken to another room, where he finds Mayu, his first love! "Now, as punishment, you must touch each other's bodies!" What? That's the punishment? It's not hell, it's heaven!

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Published in 18 episodes, compiled into 6 long-form chapters.

title.native: すんっっっ止め地獄のチェリーボーイ

184310.description:
Chef Sua, with her unrivaled culinary skills, doesn't just rule over Peace Restaurant, Seoul's most peculiar eatery -- she weaves harmony between cosmic enemies now seated as tablemates. The tension in her restaurant simmers not from culinary rivalry but from the precarious peace among patrons from warring dimensions. Will Sua's culinary diplomacy be enough to maintain this balance, or is her restaurant destined to become the epicenter of an ultimate showdown?

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.native: 最強最高の魔法少女は絶対負けない
title.romaji: Saikyou Saikou no Mahou Shoujo wa Zettai Makenai

184312.description:
During Class 1-A's Quirk training, in preparation to hunt down the remaining members of the League of Villains and the Paranormal Liberation Front, Mina asks Izuku if it's confusing to manage six other Quirks while using One For All. Izuku says it is, but that aspect's manageable thanks to the Sixth User's advice to visualize all of them as tools being swapped around.

Note: A Piece of Cake serves as a prequel to My Hero Academia: You're Next and was given out for first admission of the movie screening.

title.native: Aア PIECEピース OFオブ CAKE
パラダイス・レディー

184314.description:
After transmigrating into the body of a terminally ill villainess, Ibellin decides to find a peaceful life and a happy ending instead. Rather than selling off the main villain, Raven, to get the expensive medicine needed to treat her illness, Ibellin decides to heal the boy and then quickly send him on his way. But when Raven's father comes to seek her out, Ibellin is given a choice she's never imagined before. Will she accept it, or will she decline in hopes of finding happiness elsewhere?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: A Terminally Ill Villainess Refuses to Be Adopted

184315.description:
As if dying from overwork doesn’t suck enough, imagine being reincarnated as a minor novel character who will also meet a pitiful end soon. With nothing to lose, Adelia makes the perilous journey to become the empire’s first white mage in 300 years. Why? To have the crown prince marry her so she can have the power to get revenge on her abusive family, of course! And once she becomes a member of the imperial family, Adelia can live happily receiving the love of her favorite character, Princess Ariana. But wait, she never asked for Crown Prince Lucian’s affection too...!

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: Je vous jure, je n'aime que la Princesse !

title.english: No, I Only Charmed the Princess!

184316.description:
Used as a bargaining chip to protect the House of Eagles, Shupena, a tiny blue bird, finds herself betrothed to the heir of the House of Lions, Ricador Chadwick. As the villainess who is later tossed aside once he meets the real female lead, she hopes to keep her distance until a divorce can happen. But when Ricador shows much warmth and attachment for Shupena, will it still be possible to resist the temptation of getting closer? Or will the winds carry her into the arms of her new husband?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Bluebird Lady and the White Lion Family

title.english: Lady Blue Bird of the White Lion Family

184317.description:
I'll be the one calling the shots.
After enduring an upbringing full of torment, Lady Arianne refuses to be used as a means to anyone's end but her own. When her father moves to have her sold off as an additional mistress to the crown prince, she takes matters into her own hands by proposing a contract marriage with a duke instead!

(Source: Manta)

title.english: I Don't Want to Be a Lady

184318.description:
At the top of the demon tribe, the Demon Lord's daughter lived an easy life. Until one day when death suddenly came to her door!!

(Source: Sunday Webry, translated)

title.native: 魔王の娘は、死にたくない。

184319.description:
Nanase moved to Tokyo to attend university. She dreamed of a sparkling college life, but she has been unable to make friends and ends up spending her days all alone… Until one day, she meets Hiyama-san, a senior boy, and it rocks her world! She wants to be with Hiyama-san and get to know all about him. Hiyama's unexpected kindness and good-natured attitude only makes Nanase like him more…? A love affair that begins from the moment they meet! A sweet first-love campus romance!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
synonyms: Whoever loved that loved not at first sight?

title.native: まことの恋をするものは
title.romaji: Makoto no Koi wo suru Mono wa

184320.description:
"Can we keep it a secret, just between the two of us?''

In an empty classroom, the teacher kisses me… Ena, a serious but shy high school girl who is overshadowed by her popular and talented older sister, secretly confesses to her art teacher, Asami. She is in love with him, because he was kind to her and treated her as a unique individual, not just someone's "younger sister." Ena couldn't tell anyone about her feelings, but she did tweet about them on SNS.

But one day, she witnesses her beloved Asami-sensei and her sister kissing! Ena could only cry in anguish, as her love begins to become something worse!?

(Source: MechaComic, translated)

synonyms: ロマンはコスチューム！〜明日は何のコスプレしようかな？〜

184324.description:
After more than ten years together, Seojin’s boyfriend walks out without warning, only to announce he’s engaged to her boss’s daughter. When her life feels completely dried out, a man appears and pulls her into a one-week summer romance she assumes will fade like a dream. But the real shock comes later: that same man is introduced as a CEO at her new job. A thrilling adult office romance between guarded secretary Hyeon Seojin and her bold, relentlessly straightforward new boss, Chae Juwan.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: 私には優しすぎる上司
บังเอิญรักบอสคนใหม่

184325.description:
"You shall live and suffer for eternity, trapped within your armor, prisoners of time."

Enoch's life is turned upside down when his entire family is slaughtered overnight by the cursed knights. The knights wander, sentenced by the witch's curse to a fate of endless empty slaughters. Enoch trampled under their trail of blood, burns for a vengeance that outlasts, outdoes eternity. Who will be whose fate? Who is the one that orchestrates their conflicting fates?

(Source: WEBTOON)

184327.description:
Only a small fraction of the world gets a flashy, impressive power, but even that’s more common than not having one. Before she knows it, Joori Ahn is almost through her twenties and still powerless. She tells herself that’s better than getting a weird one—something the universe must have taken as a challenge. This isn’t just any weird power; this is a curse! Except, if her clothes transforming in front of her crush gets him to finally notice her, who could blame her for testing the waters?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes seven extra chapters.

title.english: When the Curse Strikes at Midnight

184329.description:
Seyeong's lips met Jeha’s, a seal being pressed to paper, igniting an overwhelming rush of pleasure that left his breath ragged. Instinctively, Jeha's tongue sought hers, hungry and primal, as though he were a beast claiming its prey. Just as he lost himself in the moment, a sudden slap on his back jolted him back to reality. He pulled away, laughing bitterly, brushing the back of his hand against her flushed lips. The cool night air did nothing to quell the heat surging through Seyeong’s body, her skin damp with sweat. That single kiss was so intense, it left her breathless—wondering just how much more her body could endure beyond that single, fiery connection…

(Source: Lezhin US)

184330.description:
Kiritani, a young yakuza gang leader, is ordered to take care of the daughter of the yakuza godfather who controls the entire Kanto region. However, the young lady has a very peculiar fetish…

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

184331.description:
From the moment Princess Raha's eyes turned blue—the color symbolic of the imperial heir—she has wanted nothing but death. After her brother seized the throne, he sent her an endless stream of bedchamber slaves captured from conquered lands, but none emerged alive. None until Shane Hildes.

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: Sous les draps de la princesse

184332.description:
From the outside, Taesung and Haeun look just like real siblings. They were certainly raised that way, living together in the same house since they were kids. But here’s the secret: they aren’t actually related. Haeun’s just been living with Taesung’s family since her parents went to live abroad, and that’s the way it’s been for the last 15 years. They’re basically real sister and brother at this point…until one day, Taesung comes to learn a prank from his friends. Grab a girl’s sides, and you can tell from her reaction what she really thinks of you. Taesung tries this out on Haeun that night, eager to see how she reacts…and accidentally ends up grabbing her boobs. Uh-oh. But just what is up with Haeun’s reaction? She’s blushing, squirming, not saying anything… Is this how you would normally act in front of your brother? Things come to light, and Taesung’s starting to look at his “sister” a little bit differently now…

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: 秘密の姉弟２〜この関係に問題あり!?〜

184333.description:
Yeon is the sole survivor of a devastating fire that took everything from her: her home, her status, and her family. Cast aside by the society she once called her own, she learns to survive in isolation, forging her own path. One stormy day, she is drawn by the sorrowful cries of an unusual creature, only to find a mysterious boy with snow-white hair and piercing amber eyes lying in the rain. She names him "Bibi," after the soft, sorrowful sounds he was making when she found him. Bibi remembers nothing of his past or how he came to be on earth…all he knows now is that he feels an undeniable connection to the sky, and a fierce determination to keep Yeon by his side by any means necessary.

(Source: Lezhin US)

184337.description:
A comedic action fantasy about two country bumpkins who leave their rural estate to pursue their dreams of becoming knights!

(Source: DAYcomics)

184338.description:
Edele Lancaster is the perfect noble lady who has been groomed for the job. But when her husband whom she married reluctantly commits treason, she is branded a traitor and becomes a slave. Distraught, she tries to kill herself to preserve honor as a noble lady, but her new master, Count Laslo Krissus prevents her from doing so. Will Edele be able to find freedom and happiness in her new life as Count Krissus’ maid?

(Source: WEBTOON)

184339.description:
Cheoldu, a barbarian raised on Earth, lives a mundane life with his best friend Jintae. But when he sees an alien creature from his planet on the news, everything changes. Thrown into an apocalyptic challenge, Cheoldu and Jintae must adjust their lives in Nova, a savage world filled with goblins and ogres. Will the two conquer Nova’s perils and uncover the secrets that could change Earth’s fate? An epic tale of friendship, survival, and untamed adventure awaits.

(Source: WEBTOON)

184340.description:
“You’ll get hurt if you’re close to him.”
“I don’t know why he’s so unlucky.”
“Yeonjae, I’m scared of you…”

Lee Yeonjae, avoided by everyone as if just being near him beings misfortune. Even he thinks it’s weird. Why do bad things only happen around me? I wonder how it feels to live a life of being loved and not hurting those around me. But, was even wishing for that too much? —Bam!! After an accident, I woke up in a strange place facing a mysterious entity.

“Strange. You should’ve died according to your fate, so why are you still alive?”

One truth I learned after meeting that entity is, I can avoid misfortune if I act like someone else. To survive, I have to become an actor.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: The Genius Actor Who Brings Misfortune

184341.description:
Jin-Wol Ma, better known in the martial realm as the ‘Mad Demon’, once stained the earth with blood in his pursuit to become the pinnacle of all living things. That was until his final battle with the Five Supreme Masters, where the leader of the Fire Dragon sect sealed him away using the Demon-Sealing Sword. Now, three thousand years later, Jin-Wol awakens, but he is no longer on Earth. Instead, he finds himself surrounded by hostile alien civilizations. Will Jin-Wol rise once again to aim for the peak of all living creatures?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

184342.description:
Rising star Han Sia wins the Best New Actress award for her debut performance. Amid the celebration, she catches the eye of top actor Jeong Hyeok, who shows clear interest in getting closer to her. Although Sia feels an inexplicable sense of familiarity and longing towards Jeong Hyeok, her newfound success also attracts the envy of actress Sally, who feels threatened by Sia’s achievements and Jeong Hyeok’s attention. Sally begins to sabotage Sia at every turn, and as her hostility escalates, Sia starts to experience vivid visions of an ancient kingdom. In these visions, she encounters figures who eerily resemble Sally and Jeong Hyeok. As the echoes of a forgotten past rise to the surface, a story unfolds of long-buried memories, unfulfilled revenge, and a love that has endured through the ages.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: アカシア～時を超えた愛～

184344.description:
Tae-Jin suddenly gains the ability to perceive others’ hidden desires. Overwhelmed, he’s first faced with the desire of his aunt, who raised him as if he were her own…

“I wish Tae-Jin would look at me as a woman…"

(Source: DAYcomics)

184345.description:
During his innocent and ignorant high school days, Suyeong had a very awkward first kiss with his first love, Chaeri. Before he could resolve the misunderstanding, Chaeri transferred to another school, and years passed by, with his first love buried in his heart. After completing his military service, Suyeong goes to an opening party and encounters Chaeri, who had come in as a transfer student. He is swayed by Chaeri’s advances and realizes he’s in for a surprise…

”What would you do if I gave you a chance to make up for it?”

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
synonyms: Swim in the Cherry หวานรักรสเชอร์รี
スイム・イン・ザ・チェリー

184346.description:
Orphaned at a young age, Yu Yoohui has always had the worst luck, even dying at a young age from a rare disease. But then, she awakens in the Joseon dynasty during the cruel reign of Lee Yoon, the most ruthless king in history. Now trapped in the body of a lowly servant, Yoohui is forced to serve the infamous tyrant, but nothing is as it seems within the palace, with secrets, lies, and dangerous desires running rampant. Can Yoohui survive the king's wrath and change the course of history, or will the bloody past consume her?

(Source: Lezhin US)

184347.description:
All this is for the Empire. Luca had never once questioned his dream of joining Accretia’s Imperial Guard. Not until he met Ilay, that is. The most unexpected of friends, Ilay’s personality and family background are nothing like Luca’s. However, it is through their differences that the two friends will begin to shape not only each other, but even the very planet on which they live.

(Source: WEBTOON)

184348.description:
Yujun, a loyal member of the Hwaseo Gang, goes undercover in the rival Gangho Gang to retrieve a secret ledger that contains incriminating evidence against his boss, Congressman Jang Seok-jun. Successfully catching the eye of Gangho’s ruthless boss, Kwon Jaeha, Yujun tries to secure his position by pleading for his life and offering to do anything Jaeha asks. But when Jaeha responds with a chilling demand, “Strip down,” Yujun realizes that survival in this dangerous game demands more than just loyalty—it requires total submission. This gripping story explores deception, power plays, and the price of betrayal.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

184349.description:
Aini Miccola, the illegitimate child of a countryside baron, is the talk of the Royal Academy. The boys can’t get enough of her cuteness, and the girls seethe at her blatant ignorance of noble conduct…but as she makes a name for herself, three others are gaining notoriety as the “villainesses” of the academy: Serafina, daughter of a powerful marquess and fiancée to the crown prince; Sandra, a viscount’s high-minded daughter with a once-in-a-generation talent for business; and Bernardetta, cunning attendant to the prime minister and heiress to a house with close ties to the royal family. When the three villainesses go toe-to-toe with Aini the apprentice saint, what paths will each of them choose?

(Source: Yen Press)

One day, a fisherman receives a messenger from the lord Korbes. The messenger says that the lord wants golden berries that live in Lake Fluft, and asks the man to help him catch them.
Lake Fluft is a sacred place where the water god lives, so fishing is a little hesitant, but the man is tempted by the reward and visits the lake to cast his net in

184357.description:
Mano is a rather dull man who works as a tattoo artist in a corner of town.
A customer visits Mano today.
Unusually for a new customer, he asks for the "Omakase" tattoo.
Why did this timid-looking man decide to get a tattoo?

184358.description:
Azuma and his partner Tanno run the "Azuma Agency Service."
The two make a living by searching for lost items on request.
One day, they receive a request from a mother who wants them to search for a keychain that her child dropped.
The client appears to have a story.
What kind of drama unfolds behind this lost item?

A 40-page story about the searcher buddy duo.

184359.description: One Shot published in the Aokishi 11A Issue

184360.description: One-shot featuring Messiah-chan from Nezumi no Hatsukoi.

184362.description: Sae Yomoda was never interested in idols. Until one day she meets an underground idol down the streets. Ao (his name) invited her to his live show and promised to make her smile. In this world Sae found herself falling into, fans would cross any line to support their "faves"...!

184377.description:
At just nine years old, Kiri leaves his sleepy village in the countryside and sets out to make a living for himself. With the help of a traveling merchant, Kiri reaches a bustling seaside town—where he’s betrayed and almost sold into slavery. He manages to escape, but now he’s all alone in the strange town with neither a roof over his head nor a coin in his pocket. The streets lead him to the Raging Kelpie’s Tail, a guild of adventurers. Its colorful characters take Kiri under their wing and watch over the earnest boy as he overcomes challenges and grows both in height and spirit.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.english: They Don’t Know I’m Too Young for the Adventurer’s Guild
title.native: 冒険者ギルドが十二歳からしか入れなかったので、サバよみました。
title.romaji: Boukensha Guild ga Juuni-sai kara Shika Haire na Katta node, Saba Yomimashita.

184379.description:
After suddenly being fired despite serving as a hero for 30 years, Alec was left with nowhere to turn. Orphaned from a young age, he had no parents to rely on, and having been a hero since childhood, he lacked basic common sense. With nowhere else to go, Alec ends up at an unexpected place—a slave market!?

There, he encounters the beautiful and kind-hearted Lilicia...

This is the story of an unwittingly strongest protagonist and an angelic heroine weaving an excessively naughty second life together.

(Source: Square-Enix, translated)

Jun-Ho finds a job in a company run by his first love and her daughter. He can't keep his hands to himself when his crush lets her guard down...

184390.description:
Mokume is a first-year college student and occult fanatic! She hunts down an older student, Kugutsu, who is rumored to attract urban legends of all kinds... What will happen when she joins the Occult Club? The long-awaited occult comedy from the creator of “Janji”, Kazuki Hiraoka!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

Note: Includes seven extra chapters.

After waking up in the middle of the woods, on a rainy night, and in the body of a novel's villainess, Ophelia Lizen just wants one thing... a divorce! But she is married to Duke Sylvester Lizen, who genuinely seems fond of her and lets her do anything her heart desires — even if that's stalking the crown prince. Wanting to shed her wicked ways, Ophelia tries to turn over a new leaf, but how can she when Sylvester's one divorce condition is for her to seduce the crown prince who despises her?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Honey, Why Can't We Get a Divorce?
悪×悪夫婦、離婚させていただきます！
There Is No Need For the Tyrant Second Male Lead's Obsession
I Don’t Need the Obsession of the Tyrant

184478.description:
After dying in an experiment, Anisha wakes up in the past at the orphanage where she was sold to a mad scientist. However, things take a different path when she is adopted by Duke Aubrey to replace his late daughter, Annette. Though having to live as someone else, she decides to enjoy her new freedom while plotting revenge on the scientist. But as she starts to recall facts unknown in her former life, Anisha wonders if it's a side effect of the experiments or if her past holds deeper secrets…

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Soon Became the Contract Daughter of a Ruined Family

184480.description:
In my past life, I was praising my professor as a graduate student; in my present life, I’m praising my younger brother as an older sister. To survive in the Duke’s household where I was adopted, I absolutely have to get on the good side of Kilian, the male lead of the novel. Fortunately, it’s still a long way before the original novel’s events unfold! Reina strives to survive by diligently flattering, running errands for, and offering snacks to the young male lead Kilian, who will eventually eliminate her in the future. “Sister, you have to marry me too.” What…? Did I win his favor too well by using my past life’s skills to the fullest? This little chubby kid is proposing. I tried to dismiss it as a child’s prank, “You’ve never been my sister. If anything, you’re a woman to me.” Suddenly, a deep voice echoed. When did he grow up so much? Unaware of the passage of time, Reina, who only thinks about escaping, and the obsessive male lead Kilian, who only cares about his sister, engage in a game of cat and mouse in their romance.

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: Survive as the Adopted Daughter of a Genius Duke

184481.description:
Iris Sabrina sets out from home to the capital to fulfill her dream of becoming a knight. However, her journey takes an unexpected turn when she’s mistaken for her twin sister—whom she never knew existed—Arke Bright, a notorious villainess who’s been missing for months. As Iris struggles to navigate life in the capital and prove she’s not her sister, she meets a family she never knew she had and a handsome prince who helps her unravel the truth behind her sister’s dark past.

(Source: Tapas)

184482.description:
The genius has arrived! A drama about love and pudding for elementary school students!!

(Source: Sunday Webry)

184483.description:
Teacher returns?

The story of witches' struggle to keep the beach safe!

(Source: Sunday Webry, translated)

184484.description:
“This town is a beehive.”

A small, isolated, backward mountain town where everyone is born, raised, and lives together all their lives. A boy named Han Woo-bin, who has been bullied since childhood, his whole life. Woo-Bin’s only hope is to save up money and escape from this town as soon as possible. However, the bigger the spark of hope grows, paradoxically, the bigger the tragedy becomes..

(Source: Namu Wiki, translated)

184485.description:
Leon Winston, Captain of the Western Command's Domestic Intelligence Division in the Kingdom of Riphon, is both feared and revered. Known as the Vampire of Camden for his ruthless treatment of rebels, he strikes terror into both allies and enemies alike. But beneath his noble and elegant exterior lies a man consumed by a dark desire, one that burns as fiercely as his rage against the rebels. Sally Bristol, the unassuming maid in charge of the interrogation room, is the one who awakens this uncontrollable craving, fueled by the scent of her blood. And after a rebel spy mentions her name, Leon realizes he no longer has to suppress his violent desire for her. Will Sally be able to beg her way out of Leon's deathly grasp, or will she succumb to the bloodlust he can't resist?

(Source: Lezhin US)

184487.description:
Gyu Park is a survivor who predicted and prepared for the coming apocalypse. In this ruined world, he is willing to do anything and everything he can to protect the comforts of his bomb shelter.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: หลุมหลบภัยวันสิ้นโลก

184488.description:
Jae-i opens her eyes in a pit of corpses. She makes a blood contract with Ban, whom she fatefully meets, and becomes the bride of Bampier. Jae-i and Ban, who have different goals, board the same ship of fate and head to Seoul to find their enemy Jacob while searching for the lover in their lost memories.

(Source: Naver Webtoon, translated)

184489.description:
For indie band vocalist Hoyeong, music is everything—his passion, his life, his identity. But when the charismatic CEO of a famous fashion label, Lee Yijun, approaches him with an unexpected offer to model for his brand, Hoyeong’s world is turned upside down. As their creative worlds of music and fashion collide, Ho-Young finds himself drawn into a whirlwind of emotions, desires, and unexpected connections that challenge everything he thought he knew about himself. In the tension between fame and authenticity, will Hoyeong be able to find his true voice?

(Source: Lezhin US)

184490.description:
Shin Wooseo was once devastated to find out that his ring connected him to Kang Jigeon, the older brother of his long-term friend and secret crush, Kang Jiseok. But after learning how Jigeon has felt about him all this time, Wooseo finally comes to accept his true soulmate. And now that the two ring partners have become an official couple, it’s time they do more than “only” sleep together while holding hands. Or at least that’s what Wooseo expects on their first trip together. So why won’t Jigeon make any moves on him…?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: These side stories are denoted to be mature.

184491.description:
They called him the Calamity Sword—a rogue Mudang elder feared by the arrogant and revered by the common folk. Jeong-Hyun, once the scourge of corrupt warriors, now lives a quieter life after the death of his old friend, Mu-Baek Son, the Heavenly Demon and ruler of the Temple of the Radiant Heaven. Entrusted with Mu-Baek’s granddaughter, So-Jin, Jeong-Hyun gains more than just a ward—he gains a second chance at life and purpose.

(Source: Tapas)

184493.description:
Kiryu Umon is a man disowned by his own father, forced to live as a vagrant, until his supposedly-estranged father suddenly calls him back. Now he finds himself undertaking a mission for the shogun Yoshimune! His job is to help deliver something from Nagasaki to Edo… But as factions collide, this will mark the beginning of a tumultuous journey!

(Source: Sunday Webry, translated)

184494.description:
After a fatal tragedy, our heroine wakes up as Aurora, a character from a novel she once read. While coming to grips with her new reality, she’s sent to marry the Duke of Ettica, a.k.a. infamous piece of trash. This trash duke knows no bounds!

"Could you punch me right now?" Not only is he a scumbag, he's a perv too?!

"If I end up falling for you, I will become your loyal little dog." What has Aurora gotten herself into?

Perhaps it’s the start of a puppy love…? Or perhaps it’s leading to something more…

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Yukiya gets sexually aroused when people watch him. He dances at a members-only show club.
One day, his ex-boyfriend from junior high school, Chika, comes to work at the club as a guard. Unlike the old days, he is surprised to see Chika, who has worked out and grown into a muscular man. He is happy to see him again and gently asks him to meet him again.
When Chika stares at him, he feels a rush of pleasure that he has never felt before, and he can’t resist. He kisses him forcibly, and he is melted by his kisses…!

(Source: Frontier Works, translated)

184499.description:
Go Yang-Sun, who is fat from birth, enters Dr. Park's diet club because her parents are nagging her. Although Dr. Park seems suspicious, her history is more reliable than anyone else's. This place boasts a 100% success rate, and there is only one condition for leaving: "You must lose all of your target weight!"

Will Yang-Sun, who weighs over 100kg, be able to successfully diet and leave this place with a smile?!

(Source: Naver, translated)

184501.description:
Everyone wants Soo-Hyun Choi--he's tall, muscular, gorgeous, and he's a talented interior designer. But there's something people don't know. Soo-Hyun's ex wrecked his confidence by saying he was a boring lay, and now he can't get it up! He decides that the only solution is to switch positions and become a bottom. But it's hard for someone Soo-Hyun's size to find a top who's big enough to dominate him. He moves from company to company while searching for his dream man. As he leaves his latest job after another failed attempt, he looks up to see the newest employee—the man of his dreams!

"I'd like to renew my contract!"

(Source: Netcomics)
synonyms: เหตุผลด้านหัวใจ
センチメンタル リーズン

184502.description:
Chef Kim, Korea's legendary sashimi master, is transported into the world of Blessing M, a mobile game he once played. But instead of being a hero, he finds himself as Geomma Kang, a mere background extra. Forced into a new life, Geomma discovers a new power: the Blessing of the Blade God. Now, to survive in this game-like world, he must slice through challenges and enemies alike. Will his unmatched skills in the kitchen be enough to carve out a new destiny?

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: Conquering the Academy with Just a Sashimi Knife
I Took Over the Academy with a Single Sashimi Knife

184504.description:
Dimension Wave—a super popular VRMMO game where players can experience several years of fantasy in just twenty-four hours of real time. Enticed by the entry ticket his sisters won, a young man takes part in the project's Second Wave. However, as soon as he enters the world of the game, he finds that his sisters have played a trick: he's been transformed into a girl with the cringy name Kizuna†Exceed. But instead of letting it get to him, he decides to chill and take this new life as it comes. Without sparing a fraction of a second deciding, Kizuna immediately chooses to fish rather than fight on the front lines in this fantasy world. Alongside his sisters, Kanade and Tsumugi, a Japanese-style beauty named Shouko, Yamikage the fake ninja, and other quirky comrades, he works to enjoy his second life to the fullest.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.native: ディメンションウェーブ

184509.description:
︀︀The Fukurougi Incident: a heinous case in which twenty-three murderers fell victim to active-duty police officer Nodoka Fukurougi. Nodoka is put to death for her crimes, but as it turns out, her story’s far from over—a mysterious girl appears before her and invites her to take part in a twisted game. Thirteen vicious murderers are to be revived and take part in a brutal battle royale, Nodoka included. If she wants to uphold justice and make sure the evil stay dead, Nodoka has no choice but to slaughter her way to the end...!

(Source: Yen Press)

184519.description:
You know how they say “never meet your heroes”? Well, what if you’re literally about to die? Failed hunter Minato spent his entire life dreaming of becoming just like the 106 Progenitors, a heroic band of transcendents who defeated the Tower of Monsters three centuries ago, but he never expected to meet them in his dying moments when his high-school bully tries to kill and scapegoat him for looting their tomb. The Progenitors offer him a second lease on life by letting one of them take over his body, but that’s not enough for Minato: he wants them all!

(Source: WEBTOON)

184521.description: The Family Show tells the story of a depressed, impoverished family who, in an attempt to make money, begin to distribute the story of their lives. Mikoto, the daughter of the Masaki family, laughs at school about her family's poverty. Her way of relieving stress is to satisfy her need for approval by distributing videos. However, the delivery triggers a downward spiral into hell for the girls and their family.

184524.description:
Injection rehab boner care... Nurse's secret exposed. ❤

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in COMIC X-EROS #64.

184525.description:
Jisu Kim inherited a peculiar power from her mother: the ability to see and hear ghosts. When an old spirit starts to meddle in her life, she gets transmigrated to a novel she recently read but barely remembers. Now she must live as Fluerty Bebenia, the daughter of a duke. Trapped in the body of a side character doomed to die, Fluerty must use her power to change the novel and ensure her survival. If that means having to marry the handsome, aloof Grand Duke Dever Noctis, then so be it!

(Source: Tapas)

184526.description:
In the grand empire of Tygen, Robellia's serene life takes a dark turn, catapulting her into a saga of vengeance. In a world of power and intrigue, she exposes hidden truths, navigating a tumultuous path between hero and villain. Armed with extraordinary magic, Robellia is steadfast in unveiling the obscured secrets of the empire and recovering her lost happiness.

(Source: PocketComics)

Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.

184527.description:
Evrielle Solgren is devastated by the death of her father. Living in the capital with her tutor, she didn’t even get to see him one last time before the north was sieged by monsters from beyond The Curtain. It was almost too much for a 14-year-old to bear...before she was killed and woke up in her five-year-old body. Now that she has been given this opportunity, Eve will do everything in her power to save her beloved father and stop The Northern Curtain from falling.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: ฉันก็แค่ดูแลพ่อผู้ขี้โรค

184528.description: Serving as collateral for her parents' debt, she is forced to transform into the magical warrior "Yuri Cure". As she reluctantly goes to the battlefield to deal with the sudden appearance of a monster, the monster in question turns out to be a dorky girl...

title.native: わたしが世界を救う理由
title.romaji: Watashi ga Sekai wo Sukuu Riyuu

184529.description:
Everyone's shocked when 9-year-old prodigy Adelia Ester suddenly refuses to enroll in the elite knights' academy. They don't know that Adelia was magically sent back in time after wasting her life on the battlefield and suffering an early death! Now, Adelia's out to protect her peace from her ex-boss, the evil future emperor, by setting her ally on the throne instead. Will Adelia succeed in one last mission and finally retire for good? Or will she find herself forced to be a hero once more?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I'm Done Being a Hero, Even If It's Retirement
ไม่เอาแล้ววีรสตรี ชาตินี้ขอเกษียณดีกว่า

184530.description:
After completing all 200 endings of her favorite game "Nayla", a girl is given a 201st playthrough. She accepts and wakes up in the game as Claudia, Nayla's wicked sister who always meets a grim fate. Desperate to survive, she proposes a marriage contract with the cursed prince, Nathan, to achieve the goal of making a pact with five spirits. Meanwhile, the seemingly virtuous heroine Nayla is determined to frame Claudia as evil. Is Claudia truly the villainess, or is there more to her story?

(Source: Tapas)

184532.description:
Biyeon always hoped to be a baby in a romance fantasy webtoon and live idly if she were ever reborn. So she's shocked when she gets her wish... but as an infant in the world of martial arts! Nevertheless, despite brutal training and harsh realities, Biyeon tries her best to form new relationships and become a true member of the Hwasan Sect. With the knowledge from her past life and the support of Hwasan disciples, can Biyeon rise to the top and find the life she dreamed of in this world?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Became the Youngest Disciple of the Hwasan Sect

title.english: The Youngest Disciple of the Hwasan Sect

184533.description:
Ryeon knew from the moment she was born that her life was a cursed one. Born sickly in a martial arts family meant she had nothing else to do other than wait for death. And when that icy embrace came, it delivered not peace but a second chance at life! Regressed to her days as a child, Ryeon resolves to cure herself and live a long, healthy life for the sake of herself and her family.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Time Limited Elixir of the Fallen Sega

title.english: The Overflowing Elixir of the Fallen House

184534.description:
After her first molt reveals red feathers symbolic of a curse, Lindsey Raniero of the Eagle Clan is shunned by her family and dies alone. She awakens in the past, only 7 years old. Wishing to escape her fate, Lindsey takes her bird form to run away and makes a deal with the rival Wolf Clan: She will wed their ailing heir and heal him with her clan's power in exchange for their protection. But surrounded by wolves and with her family now on her tail, can this little bird live to spread her wings?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Beloved New Baby of the Wolf Manor

184535.description:
Estella Margaret Montiel is a dedicated governess for House Bertha. However, she is currently facing more pressing matters than math or grammar. She knows her pupils' half-brother, Duke Diego Bertha, plans to kill everyone in his family! Determined to protect her students from a tragic fate, she sets out to reform the charming yet dangerous duke. Can her resolve and guidance truly transform the devilish Diego and teach him the value of family? Or will her class be dismissed much too early?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Immoral Duke's Family Needs to be Homeschooled
闇堕ちした公爵家には家庭教育が必要です

title.english: The Immoral Duke Needs to Be Homeschooled

184536.description:
Yuuki, an alpha lawyer, has been in a friends-with-benefits relationship with his colleague Watase, also an alpha, since a certain incident. Frustrated with always being the one held, Yuuki is eager to turn the tables on Watase. Meanwhile, Watase, though casually inviting Yuuki, sometimes gives him a meaningful look. Both believed their fling would end once one of them found an omega mate, but...

(Source: Media Soft, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: Even If It's not Destiny, I Love You

184537.description:
Kageyama Kanau, an ordinary office worker in his third year in the General Affairs Section, has a secret life! He’s been satisfying his hidden need for validation by posting risqué photos on the Internet. Living a mundane life, social media is his only outlet to reveal his true self. Then, a miracle happens—he’s chosen by Kiharu, the most popular "Mr. Top" in the area, and invited on a weekend date! But when Kanau arrives at the meeting point, he’s shocked to see that the person waiting for him is Doumoto Haruki, the top salesman at his own company!

(Source: Junet, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

184538.description:
Ever since Hasegawa moved into a new apartment, he has been bothered by recurring dreams “of having sex with an unknown man”...! Worried that his sleeplessness might affect his productivity at work, he reaches out to the previous resident of his new place. Once he realizes the dreams seem to be a glimpse into a future, he decides to go ahead and get it over with! He ends up asking Kuramochi, his colleague and rival at work, to lend him a hand. But he certainly did not expect the real thing to be more intense than his dreams! A love comedy between an experienced bossy extreme sadist and a serious office worker tormented by lewd visions!

(Source: Mobile Media Research)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

184539.description:
A life of kindness, and it all came to an end. If given another chance, will I live the same way?

(Source: Toomics)

184540.description:
Initially, Miyake entered a physical relationship with Oohashi as a stand-in for Takeda, Oohashi's crush. However, over time, they started living together and became more like a couple. Oohashi, who is anxious and tends to be overprotective, has grown increasingly possessive of Miyake—enough to ease Miyake’s own anxieties. Meanwhile, Miyake continues to update his “Oohashi Observation Notebook” in proportion to the time they spend together.

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

184541.description:
A straight-laced student gets caught up in the kind and overwhelming love of an older, cunning student. University student Makoto is currently his boyfriend, Ryohei. They did it all the time when they first started dating, but Ryohei suddenly won't even touch him. One night, he went out with Ryohei's friend, Yuki, when Makoto woke up after a night of drinking--he was getting spooned by Yuki! His sweet words resonated with his frustrated, pent-up body...

"Would you like me to help you relieve some of your build-up...?"

(Source: Coolmic)

title.romaji: Oazuke wa, Warui Yoru no Aizu

184542.description:
Upon entering college, Mitsuki moves in with Sakuma, his childhood friend who is ten years older. Though they've grown apart over the years, Mitsuki still admires Sakuma, but Sakuma keeps him at a distance, insisting he "stay away." One night, after Mitsuki gets drunk, Sakuma takes care of him, and Mitsuki dreams that he kisses Sakuma. Confused by his sudden feelings toward another man, Mitsuki realizes he doesn’t feel any aversion to them.

(Source: J-Publishing, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: モーニングムーンに奪われて

184543.description:
Convenience store clerk Higa Kousuke and office worker Tatemura Atsushi, are a quarrelsome couple who live by the motto “the more you argue, the closer you become." One day, Atsushi's mother, Hisae, pays him a surprise visit. Noticing how impeccably tidy the apartment is—thanks to Kousuke’s meticulousness—Hisae assumes a woman is living with him and asks to meet her. Atsushi, who has no intention of coming out, finds himself in a dilemma, unsure of how to explain his relationship with Kousuke to his mother...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

184544.description:
Mikage, a rabbit, leads a band of bandits, providing for his family and friends in a tough, remote area. His once beautiful face is now marred by a terrible scar, a painful reminder of a past encounter with a wolf. One day, Mikage ventures too far and gets captured by the wolves' leader, Tamaki. Ready to meet his fate, Mikage is instead offered a deal—his freedom in exchange for a one-night-stand with Tamaki. Despite his deep hatred for wolves, Mikage finds himself unexpectedly overwhelmed by the pleasure Tamaki gives him, experiencing the "ultimate sex" for the first time. However, this encounter leads to an unexpected month spent with Tamaki, who is in heat...

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

184545.description:
Sousuke, unexpectedly transferred to an assistant professor position in Taiwan, finds himself overwhelmed by the hot, chaotic environment and the language barrier, which leaves him feeling out of place. To make matters worse, one of his students, Toshi—a handsome man with tattoos—only heightens Sousuke's anxiety. Determined to maintain his dignity as a teacher, Sousuke struggles to keep his composure. However, despite his resolve, he begins to soften as Toshi’s care and attention make him feel something new and unfamiliar in this foreign land.

(Source: Gentosha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

184546.description:
One day, Ikuto wakes up to find Kentaro, a senior in high school, standing in front of him, calling his name and smiling warmly. The strange thing is, Ikuto has no idea who Kentaro is. Confused, Ikuto bluntly asks, "Who the hell are ya?" However, no one around him seems to find anything odd, as if Kentaro's presence is perfectly normal. Ikuto is left feeling isolated in his confusion. To make matters more unsettling, Kentaro leans in closer and asks, "Did ya really forget me?"

(Source: Mag Garden, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.romaji: Itoshii Kimi to no Shoya Jijou.: Bangai-hen

184548.description:
Kanae, a hitman, is attacked by Sara, a half-vampire, near a trash dump. With no attachment to life, Kanae is apathetic to having his blood sucked or being followed home. Sara was treated as a defective vampire and discarded by his progenitor. Starving for blood, he makes Kanae a proposal: "I'll take care of your degenerate life, and in return, you'll be my food supply!" Because of the arousing effects of bloodsucking, the two begin a physical relationship. As they discover the warmth of touch, they begin to melt each other's loneliness... This is their tale of finding love in a brutal and despicable world.

(Source: Animate International)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.
synonyms: The Garnet that Sparkles in the Junk

title.native: ゴミ溜めのガーネット

184549.description:
Saeki, a nursery school teacher who adores cute things, feels insecure about his large, bulky frame. One day, he’s tasked with training a new trainee at the daycare, only to discover it's Noa, his neighbor who playfully squeezed his pecks the night before!
"Saeki-sensei, you're so cute..."
As they spend more time together, Noa finds himself increasingly drawn not only to Saeki's soft pecks but also to his awkward yet heartfelt kindness...

(Source: MUGENUP, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: ミルクシュガーベイビー・ラブユー

184550.description:
Sudou, the apartment manager, possesses a strange ability: anyone who hears his voice is immediately charmed by him. However, things take an unexpected turn when Inose, a charismatic host from a local club, moves into Sudou's building. For the first time ever, Sudou’s voice seems to have no effect on someone...

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 愛だの恋だの効く前に
title.romaji: Ai da Koi da no Kiku Mae ni

184551.description:
Popular high school student Chihiro secretly has a fetish for hands. One day, he finds out that his delinquent classmate Saku, has the ideal hands for him. He discovers that Saku has the most beautiful hands he has ever seen, and his body reacts passionately to them. Since then, Saku, who is amused by his secret, has been using this as a reason to forcibly touch him, and Chihiro has been at the mercy of the pleasure he gets. However, through repeated play, he discovers Saku's clumsy kindness...

(Source: Frontier Works, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

184552.description:
For 10 years, omega Tosaka Jutta has been kept in a dungeon at an idol agency without a chance to debut. Suddenly, he’s given the opportunity to become the industry's first "mate idol" to promote the promising new star alpha, Yuu Takami, after a scandal threatens his career. On the surface, they act as the perfect “mates,” but Yuu, with his striking looks and exceptional acting skills, remains distant and cold toward Jutta, barely engaging with him. As Jutta attempts to connect with Yuu, things take an unexpected turn when, during a heat, Yuu catches him unintentionally making a nest out of his clothes...

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 俺たち運命じゃないのに！

184553.description:
Washinami Ui harbors a secret: he remembers his previous life as an invincible knight. Now, he’s just a small, thin high school boy dealing with a stalker. On his first day at his new school, he unexpectedly reunites with Leonhardt, his rival from that past life, and vows to keep a low profile. But out of nowhere, Leonhardt kisses him! With no recollection of their former lives, Leonhardt has transformed into a flamboyant and flirtatious guy named Shishiou Leon, the exact type of person Ui detests!

(Source: Taiyohtosho, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 元チート☆敗けっぱなし

184554.description:
Otose is a rookie voice actor with a childhood dream in his heart. While working part-time, he is suddenly summoned by his agency and learns that his first job will be voicing the lead role in a BLCD, as the original author wants to hire a rookie voice actor. To prepare for his debut, Otose takes individual lessons, only to discover that his instructor is Sakai, a legendary voice actor who played the lead in his favorite hero anime before retiring five years ago. Overwhelmed with excitement at Sakai's intense training and demonstrations, Otose begins to develop feelings that go beyond admiration. However, he learns that Sakai is HIV positive, which was the reason for his retirement from voice acting...

(Source: Shufu no Tomosha, translated)

title.romaji: Koe ga Hibiite Yuu to Nari

184555.description:
Kaito, a high school student, has just returned to Japan after a long stay abroad. Upon his return, he hears whispers about Yura, a mysterious video streamer creating a buzz with his original hair and makeup tutorials. Good-looking but jaded, Kaito dislikes people and lacks dreams or goals, leaving him feeling insecure about himself. By chance, he discovers that Yura is actually a high school delinquent, and his life changes after getting his hair done by Yura!

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

184556.description:
Yousuke is a regular member of the school's sports club, but he gets banned from participating due to a failing grade! Desperate to get back on the team, he turns to his friend Kimihiro for help.

(Source: Rokkasha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

184559.description:
In the Blueforest duchy near the border, there is a city where "humans," "demons," and "gods" coexist — it's the most exciting but dangerous place in the world. Every day, Ryan, a fifteen-year-old boy who currently serves as the Duke of Blueforest, along with his beloved "wife" Rei, must face the cataclysmic dangers that can be created by a whim of the gods.

One day, Ryan decides to take in a girl he rescued from the battlefield…

"Is it okay if I call you 'Papa'?"

The girl's name is Amadeus. She is a terrifying being known as the "Apocalypse Divine Dragon," a potential disaster in human form. However, to Ryan and his wife, who have longed for a child of their own, she is nothing more than a dearly beloved daughter they could never love enough! In other words, it's an unstoppable wave of love and affection!!

"Ahhh, my daughter's cuteness has reached lethal levels!!"

To protect his family and the world, Ryan, the genius mage, must become the most powerful and coolest dad! An undebatably adorable and heartwarming 'Father-Daughter' fantasy begins now!

(Source: GA Bunko, translated)

184563.description:
Saint Eliane's engagement is called off out of the blue by her fiancée, the crown prince Claude, who then banishes her from the kingdom. Fed up with Claude's incessant bullying and unfaithfulness, Eliane sets off to a neighboring kingdom in the hopes of starting a new life. It is then that she meets Nigel, a man of sincerity and an exact opposite of Claude...

(Source: Kodansha USA)
synonyms: Even Though I Was the Real Saint, I Was Exiled - Which Means It's Already Over for My Country

title.english: Because I, the True Saint, was Banished, that Country is Done For!
title.native: 真の聖女である私は追放されました。だからこの国はもう終わりです
title.romaji: Shin no Seijo de Aru Watashi wa Tsuihou saremashita. Dakara Kono Kuni wa Mou Owari desu

184564.description:
Taiki Inomata, in his third year of junior high, ended his final junior high badminton tournament with a loss, which left him feeling unsatisfied. One day, while he was at school working on his summer assignments with Kyou and Hina, Hina suggested, “Let’s do something summery to make one last good memories of middle school!” While pondering what they could do at this late hour, Taiki headed off to practice badminton on his own, only to be unexpectedly told by the club advisor that he could join the high school squad practice starting tomorrow—⁉ Also included are episodes from Yumeka’s junior high days, as well as those of Hariu and Karen‼ A new novel depicting where “youth” begins to unfold, before the main story starts‼

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

184565.description:
"Love makes people go crazy."

Hikaru's always been told to be wary of love—it can make you do stupid things. Like abandon your dreams, or worse, fail your exams! Which is exactly what happens when she falls in love at first sight with Kairi Kira. The problem is, Hikaru's dreams of one day living it up in an expensive penthouse apartment relies on her first achieving academic success. Which is why she's going to have to nip this little love problem in the bud. If Kairi rejects her and breaks her heart, she'll be able to get over her feelings and focus on her grades. Except Kairi insists on becoming her girlfriend, which is definitely not part of the plan! But this should be fine, right? She just has to get used to splitting her time and attention. Or... she could, if Kairi would let her!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title.english: I Love You, Please Dump Me
title.native: 夢と恋ではつり合わない

184566.description:
"Your daughter has committed suicide," was the message received by Wataru Fukunaga, an ordinary middle-aged man. Soon after, he finds himself face to face with the unrecognizable body of his daughter. In search of the truth about her death, he discovers that she was murdered. However, during his search, Wataru himself becomes a victim. Unexpectedly, he wakes up in the past, just before the death of his daughter.

(Source: peep, translated)

title.native: 復讐パパ ～イジメ・リベンジャー～

184567.description:
Yanosuke, who is dedicated in his training with the sword, is impressed by the talents of Ayame, the only daughter of the dojo, but he is also jealous of her. Meanwhile, Ayame offers to practice with Yanosuke, even without his asking. What is her true intention?

(Source: Sunday Webry)

184568.description:
Sannomiya Makoto’s first day at a new school is filled with plenty of firsts, but he’s here for one thing: to meet Azami Yako, the daughter of a powerful CEO and his future fiancée! Knowing her only from a middle school photo, Makoto is eager to finally meet the girl he’s betrothed to—only to be extremely disappointed.

Azami Yako is far from the ideal fiancée Makoto had imagined. She’s sloppy in appearance and manners, mumbles to herself constantly, and is all in all…cringe! Will getting to know her change Makoto’s first impression, or is he being set up to marry a suspicious weirdo?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

184577.description: Deep in the mountains, a body is discovered. When this unidentifiable "thing" becomes linked to a case of stolen remains, a mysterious entity known as "Hiruko" emerges... A uniquely crafted, unprecedented Japanese tale of the bizarre, rendered with unparalleled artistry.

184578.description:
Yoon Minho may seem like your average, slightly clumsy kindergarten teacher, but she harbors a remarkable secret: the ability to travel through time. When the National Museum commissions her for another thrilling time-travel mission, she finds herself unexpectedly crossing paths with the enigmatic and aloof Park Ewan. Ewan seeks her help in locating a priceless historical artifact, and despite their less-than-ideal first encounter, they embark on a captivating journey that blurs the lines between history and romance. Join them on this exhilarating rollercoaster ride through time and love!

(Source: Lezhin US)

184579.description:
Ha-Ri Jeon is a high school student with a heart condition. One day, she is struck by a curse that causes her to zap everything and everyone around her whenever her heart races for Jeong-Won, her secret crush. Yu-Ra Baek, a brash and sharp-tongued classmate who mysteriously knows about her curse, offers her a deal—he’ll help her keep it under control if she lets him use it. Can Ha-Ri find the courage to confess her feelings to her crush? Or will she stay in the safe zone of friendship? Get ready for Ha-Ri’s electrifying first love story!

(Source: WEBTOON)

184580.description:
A couple is on a date at a coffee shop, but something seems to be wrong. What is his plan? A romantic comedy that starts with a breakup story!

(Source: Shonen Jump Plus, translated)

184581.description:
A job-hunting Grim Reaper encounters an elementary school student with a certain wish... What is the "real" job of this most un-deathlike Grim Reaper?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

synonyms: The lingering scent of a man is on my oshi

title.romaji: Osu no Kaori Tadayou Oshi no Ko.

184584.description:
Renji Shiba is 17 years old who goes to a kickboxing gym. The coaches' expectations of him are high and Renji has absolute confidence in his abilities. But unable to find anyone who exceeds his level, Renji no longer finds satisfaction in fighting. One night, returning home from the gym, the boy comes across a man wearing a Noh mask who violently assaults him, leaving him unconscious on the ground. Upon awakening, Renji will have only one goal: to seek a rematch with this worthy opponent!

Includes 3 extra chapters:
- Extra 1 "Max";
- Extra 2 "Box";
- Extra 3 "Kix".

184585.description:
"A wedding without a bride?"

Taesung Group's president, Mu-Jin Tae, is a workaholic with no interest in women. But one day, he's suddenly been given an ultimatum by his father, the chairman of the company. He must find a bride to walk down the isle with five months later. The one who's been put in charge of finding a bride for Mu-Jin is none other than his secretary, Su-Yeon Cheon, who's had a secret crush on him for nine years. But when her father, CEO of Gaon, gets into a car accident and falls into a coma, everything changes. Su-Yeon quits her job and finds herself trying to appease Gaon's stockholders about the disappearance of her older brother, who she believes should take over. But her fate changes when her "god-like" ex-boss shows up at the meeting and recommends her as the acting CEO. Su-Yeon accepts and decides to learn all she can from "the best," Mu-Jin, to save Gaon. Will her relationship with Mu-Jin be different now that she's a CEO herself? What if she was the bride that Mu-Jin needed in order to make his father happy?

(Source: Pocket Comics)
synonyms: วิวาห์เปลี่ยวรัก

184586.description:
Many would choose the sweet fantasy of a novel over reality, but not Joo-in, who wakes up as Lydia in "Reaching for the Stars." Knowing the concubine was executed by the emperor for upsetting the heroine, the new "Lydia" holes up in her palace to avoid the couple. But after she meets Mar, a mysterious man who claims to be the emperor's runaway servant, Lydia is suddenly invited to the ball, threatened by a jealous concubine, and even bumps into the heroine! Though she has no idea what caused this domino effect, the catalyst is closer to her than she thinks...

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: ファーストキスは計画通りに

184587.description:
Born under the ominous sign of "Ultimate Yang Obstruction," Dang Soun faced a turbulent life from the outset, destined to die before the age of thirty. Abandoned by his father and orphaned, he endures harsh conditions, resorting to begging and eventually gambling for survival. Despite narrowly escaping death on numerous occasions, Soun's fate takes a drastic turn when he is suddenly informed by his long-lost father and younger brother that he will become the concubine of the Demonic Sect. With his life constantly in jeopardy, survival becomes Soun's sole focus, even if it means becoming the Demonic Sect's Leader's concubine for a chance at a peaceful end.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: 魔教主之妾的生存之道

184588.description:
300 years. That was how long it had been since he had last been opened. For 3 whole centuries, the mysterious book of magic, also known as Grimoire, has been stuck on the shelf of the Le Temis Royal Academy Library. Just then, an apprentice mage opens the Grimoire, only to die in a freak accident. As the dismayed Grimoire awaits his teleportation to a new location, the library door creeps open and a mysterious girl, Riley, approaches and opens the Grimoire, becoming his new contractor.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: I Became a Legendary Archmage by Reading a Book

184589.description:
Characters from the three popular Bamboo Blade series are all here! The daily lives of their kendo clubs in 4-koma style.

Note: volume 1 contains two special chapters.

184590.description:
The story is about the journey between three pairs of childhood friends — “the childhood friends with a big height difference,” “the childhood friends who are self-conscious about their height,” and “the childhood friends with an age gap” — on their way to finally come together and start dating.

(Source: Pixiv, translated)

184592.description:
Takaku Choua is fascinated by Hazuki Shinohara, the gorgeous girl sitting next to him.

"I wish I could get to know Hazuki better. But she already seems to be living her beautiful life on her own..."

But actually, she has a communications disorder that makes it hard for her to talk to other people.

"I wish Takaku-kun would talk to me, so I could get to know him better…"

This is a “love story” of two people who fell in love with each other, but are unable to communicate even 1/3 of their feelings!

(Source: Champion Cross, translated)

title.native: 私たちはカケちがっている

184593.description:
Two sisters travel to rare sights all over Japan, casually streaming their adventures. The older sister, Kosame, works behind the scenes, and the younger sister, Koishi, presents.

(Source: Comic Nettai, translated)

title.romaji: Koishi to Kosame no Tabi Channel

184594.description:
Terasaki, the top earner in the sales department, is adored for his good looks and friendly personality. One day, he runs into Andou, a colleague who is the complete opposite of Terasaki and is not well-liked in the company, when he rushes to the restroom...?

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 聞いて、俺の恥ずかしい音

184595.description:
Lunatia, the daughter of a viscount, was nothing more than a tool exploited by her family for her "clairvoyance." Used even by her own fiancé, she eventually pays the price for her abilities by losing sight in one eye. The only future she sees awaiting her is one where all five senses are lost… Determined to live on her own terms and die an honorable death, Lunatia escapes from home. She finds refuge in the manor of the “Marquess of the Lunar Eclipse,” who is rumored to be seeking a new bride. With daring resolve, she proposes to this fearsome, seemingly inhumane man: “If you make me your bride, I will read your future once a day. You don’t have to love me. And when you no longer need me, please kill me with your own hands.” Thus begins their marriage based on these unconventional terms. Though Lunatia tries to keep her dying senses a secret, the truth starts to come apart at the seams. But why is her supposedly cold-hearted husband suddenly revealing unexpected depths of devotion...?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

title.english: The Moonlight Shines On My Fading Future
title.native: 消える私に夫の愛はいりません
title.romaji: Kieru Watashi ni Otto no Ai wa Irimasen

184596.description:
Looking to earn some extra credits, Han Wu-yeong enrolls in swimming class for the summer semester. His partner? Cha Tae-gyeong, one of Korea’s most popular singers. As the two work together to pass class, Tae-gyeong suddenly invites Wu-yeong over to his house, and they begin to dive into the waters of love!

(Source: Lezhin US)

184597.description:
"I love Leo more than anyone in the world."

Yuri and Leo are a lovey-dovey couple in the demon world. Frustrated by their laziness, Yuri's father, the Great Demon King, gives them a task: "Go to the human world and make as many humans fall to the dark side as possible." While Yuri handles the training efficiently to become a fully-fledged demon, Leo, who is kind and struggles with expressing his emotions, has a hard time progressing in his tasks... What will become of their grand romance that spans both the human and demon worlds!?

(Source: Libre, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

184598.description:
Kyouji, who quit the yakuza and now leads a quiet, retired life, is suddenly approached by a handsome foreign delivery man, Alan, who falls in love with him at first sight and passionately confesses, "I want you to be mine!" Kyouji, who just wants to live peacefully alone, firmly rejects him, but Alan's enthusiasm doesn't waver, and every day he's bombarded with intense displays of affection. At first, Kyoji resists, but gradually, he finds himself touched by Alan's strong feelings and starts looking forward to their meetings. However, Alan has a secret that he can't tell anyone...!?

(Source: Tokyomangasha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

The story of Aoi, a fork, and Mitsuri, a cake, right after they started dating.

title.romaji: Kawaisou na Kimi wa Boku dake no Amayaka na Kizu: Bangaihen

184600.description:
I want to be more than just friends.

After a chance encounter with a kind stranger, high schooler Hong finds herself lovestruck. She never expected her crush would transfer into the same homeroom class at their all-girls' school! Is this a dreaded straight-girl crush?! What's a girl to do when her feelings are mistaken for friendship?

(Source: Manta)

184601.description:
When Eun-Ho heard that the fabric softener given to him by his ex-girlfriend was discontinued, he left a complaint at the company’s customer center while drinking. Soo-In reads the complaint and is shocked and delivers all the remaining fabric softener samples. Somehow they became close and fell in love. But for Soo-In, Eun-Ho’s ex-girlfriend was too strong of a force. There was nothing she could do for him other than hug him tightly when he was sad. So now it has to be revealed. She is the one who deleted his memories.

(Source: Manta, edited)
synonyms: メモリーズ・オブ・マグノリア -モクレンの思い出-

184602.description:
Can charisma be learned?

Desperate to charm his crush, shy Tae-O buys a copy of How to Win Friends and Influence People. To his shock, the book's spirit pops out and starts giving him advice, and he sees a flicker of hope. Follow Tae-O as he learns the art of love, friendship, and social skills from a wise old fox spirit!

(Source: Manta, edited)

title.english: How to Make Friends and Win Love

184603.description:
Four guardian gods, one heart to win!

Blessed with looks and talent, Su-Ji craves a quiet life—but four stunning boys, revealed as guardian gods of the cardinal directions, are determined to win her heart. With divine suitors on her tail, can Su-Ji stay under the radar while juggling their heavenly affections?

(Source: Manta, edited)

When spiritual power reawakened in the world, Lin Qiu, who had the weakest aura, was chosen by System 9527 to be granted a new skill every day.

“Congratulations, master! You’ve obtained the skill 'Spread Your Seed'"!
Wow, that sounds exciting?

"Congratulations, master! You’ve obtained the skill 'Skill Enhancement'”!
What, I can upgrade and get even stronger?

Watch Lin Qiu game the system and turn his no-good life around!

184612.description:
From twisted games of evil demons and the roaming of the undead to strange technology that makes the impossible happen, dive into Tales of the Unusual 2, another thrilling collection of supernatural horror stories that will have you scrolling for hours. With just the right balance of dark humor and the unexpected, each short story pulls you into a new immersive world and unravels plot twists you never would've imagined. Just remember, there's nothing to be afraid of... If you have nothing to hide.

Minji may seem like an ordinary girl, but she has a secret no one knows—she’s living a double life. By day, she’s an awkward, introverted outcast, but by night, she transforms into Eunha, a stunning social butterfly. Her secret life takes an unexpected turn when a mysterious man known as "Black" approaches her with an offer:

"If you want to become a member of our secret club, you must pass a test. You must sleep with two men you are already acquainted with."

Determined to enter the exclusive club, Minji sheds her shy persona and steps into her Eunha identity, seducing everyone from a childhood friend to a sunbae at her college—even her landlord. But will Minji— or rather, Eunha— succeed in gaining entry, or will her carefully constructed double life come crashing down?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Hodaka Yuma, who has frequently transferred schools, struggles to form lasting friendships. Determined not to be forgotten after transferring, he decides to create a bold persona to stand out. Currently, Hodaka acts as a popular playboy with girlfriends scattered across the country, perfectly complementing his princely appearance. This act makes him the center of attention. However, in reality, Hodaka is an innocent boy who has never even kissed anyone. One day, the arrival of a new transfer student, Someya Masaya throws Hodaka’s carefully crafted persona into turmoil. Feeling threatened by the attention Someya receives, Hodaka is surprised when Someya asks him for advice on winning over someone he likes. But the "practice techniques" Someya suggests—like kissing and licking his chest—leave Hodaka flustered and confused…!

Though Kazuomi has always felt intimidated by Chitose's brilliance, he reluctantly agrees to a temporary engagement to appease their families while his older brother, who opposes inheriting the company, works to convince their parents otherwise. Keeping their engagement a secret, the two begin living together under the pretense of being merely roommates. However, during a party, Kazuomi accidentally consumes a drink spiked with an aphrodisiac. When Chitose comes to his rescue, he publicly declares Kazuomi as his fiancé. At first, Kazuomi assumes it’s a ploy to save him, but he’s left reeling when Chitose passionately confesses, “I want you to be my real fiancé.” The confession is sealed with a kiss so sweet it leaves Kazuomi weak at the knees—and questioning everything.
